errors.roleUnsafe: That role can't be used here right now — it may be elevated, managed, or above my own top role.

autorole.added: {role} will now be given to every new {audience} member.
autorole.alreadyAdded: {role} is already on the {audience} auto-role list.
autorole.notConfigured: That role isn't on any auto-role list.
autorole.notEnabledHint: Auto-roles are currently **off** — run `/roles autorole enable on:true` to start assigning them.
autorole.limit: You can configure at most {max} auto-roles for that audience. Remove one first.
autorole.delaySet: Auto-roles will now be given {delay} after a member finishes joining.
autorole.enabled: Auto-roles are now **on**. New members will receive the configured roles once they finish joining.
autorole.disabled: Auto-roles are now **off**. Pending delayed assignments will be skipped when they fire.

refused.elevated: That role grants an elevated permission (Administrator, Manage Server/Roles/Channels/Webhooks, Kick/Ban/Timeout Members, or Mention Everyone). Enable `allowElevatedRoles` in this plugin's config to allow it anyway.
refused.managed: That role is managed by an integration or bot and can't be given out automatically.
refused.hierarchy: That role is at or above my own highest role, so I can't grant it. Move my role above it in Server Settings → Roles.

autorole.safetyNote: Roles are re-checked at assignment time; elevated/managed/higher-than-bot roles are skipped and logged.
